0022600139.text: The Warriors (1-3, 12th in the West) are fourth in the Pacific, 2.5 games back, and are coming off a win, while the Timberwolves (3-1, 6th in the West) sit third in the Northwest, one game back, after a loss. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Yaxel Lendeborg is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision; Minnesota is missing Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Warriors lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 127-117 loss to Minnesota in San Francisco on March 13, 2026.
